pages.title: Feeding Your Dragon
pages.text: Both forms share health, hunger, and age. Bring food for the journey. Growth pauses while injured; $(l:dragonmaid:care/injury)healing comes first$(/l).
A bite to eat, then on we go.

pages.title: Shedding Scales
pages.text: After maturity, further growth can shed scales of the dragon's own color, naturally or from ordinary dragon meal, in either form. The default maturity threshold is 125 days.$(br2)Scales enter its pack first; excess drops on the ground. Global settings control maturity age, scale count and chance.
